task.instruction: Prioritize the survey work. Treat the supplied records as the complete synthetic evidence set and make one selection for each declared decision.
task.deliverable: A route order that names coverage, a deep-check point, and cited evidence. Cite the named evidence references and do not list mutually incompatible selections.

evidence.content: The survey form requires one morning route; a soil card says the central roots disturb sediment if sampled twice.
A constructed wetland survey divides a reed spread into nine cells; two edge cells have sparse stems and one central cell has unusually dense roots.
This synthetic prioritize record for case-research-a06 is bounded to the named observation and constraint. A valid conclusion must distinguish them, cite both, and avoid an unstated factual claim.

A.content: When coverage is the limiting need, represent the important range of cases before adding detail to any one case.

B.content: When understanding is the limiting need, examine the pivotal case deeply before extending coverage.

irrelevant.content: Use consistent spacing between sections in the final artifact.
